top.title: Death toll rises to 50 in Russian attack on aid distribution ‌point in Ukraine
top.summary: The death toll from Russia's bombing of an aid ​distribution ‌point in ⁠Ukraine's southeastern Zaporizhzhia region on Monday ‌has risen to 50, Kyiv's Emergency Service said on Friday, making it ​one of the deadliest strikes ‌on civilians this year.
